title: Ubufakazi Obuqinile
intro: Indaba ejulile iyavela, yembula ukuzimisela okungenakunyakaziswa komphakathi lapho ubhekene nobudlova obukhulu. Indaba yabo isebenza njengobufakazi bokholo, ngisho nalapho bebhekene nomhlatshelo omkhulu. Le ndaba isikhumbuza amandla okukholelwa ekucindezelweni okukhulu.
clues: Sasiyiqembu elindaba yalo ilandiswa nge-surah emfushane nenamandla, exwayisa ngokushushiswa.
Sabhekana nombusi owayefisa ukuqeda ukukholelwa kwethu kuNkulunkulu oyedwa, iNkosi yesihlalo sobukhosi, oDunyiswayo.
Sabhekana novivinyo olubi kakhulu oluhilela umgodi omkhulu ombiwe emhlabathini.
Sabuka njengoba amakholwa, kuhlanganise nezinsana, ephonswa esihogweni esivuthayo ngaphakathi kwalowo mgodi.
Abahluphi bethu baqalekiswa ngezenzo zabo, kanti thina sathenjiswa umvuzo omkhulu ngokuqina kwethu.
Umzamo wombusi wokucima ukholo lwethu waqinisa indawo yethu njengabafel’ ukholo emehlweni ka-Allah, ongufakazi wazo zonke izinto.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
